Name: Missing Developer's Secret Letter
Desc: A strange letter obtained from Kylie
Desc2:
Received from Kylie, this is the reward for the first challenger to complete the Simulated Battle Trial.

The envelope is simple and neatly sealed, still in perfect condition. Besides you and the writer, no one else will know what is written inside — yet that writer, whom you've never met, has now vanished into the Hollow.
